gemini-web2api.desc: 把 Google Gemini 网页端转换成 OpenAI 兼容 API 服务：无需 API Key、无需登录即可运行，支持 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/models、/v1/responses（Codex CLI）与 /v1beta/models（Gemini CLI），支持流式输出、函数调用、多模型与 @think=N 思考深度。安装后通过 http://<NAS 地址>:8081/v1 调用。

en-US.desc: Turns the Google Gemini web app into an OpenAI-compatible API service. Runs without an API key or login and supports /v1/chat/completions, /v1/models, /v1/responses (Codex CLI) and /v1beta/models (Gemini CLI), with streaming, function calling, multiple models and @think=N thinking depth. Call it at http://<NAS-IP>:8081/v1 after installation.

1.1.0.changelog: 首次发布：把 Sophomoresty/gemini-web2api 1.1.0 打包为飞牛 fnOS 原生应用，内置 httpx，安装即用，默认监听 8081 端口。

en-US.changelog: First release: packages Sophomoresty/gemini-web2api 1.1.0 as a native fnOS app with bundled httpx, listening on port 8081.
